effectsSummary: MDEA 是一种与 MDMA 类似但更温和的情感开放剂。增强共情、轻度欣快、感官感知增强。兴奋作用弱于 MDMA。
dosageRemark: MDEA 的效力低于 MDMA。效果较温和，兴奋作用也较弱。
generalRisks: 高热、血清素综合征。咬紧牙关、心率增加。风险与 MDMA 相似但通常较轻。
longtermRisks: 定期使用可能导致神经毒性和血清素系统损伤。
saferUse: [TBT] Take breaks from dancing at parties and get some fresh air in between.
[TBT] Take regular breaks from consumption. The body needs time to recover.
[TBT] People taking medication are advised to inform themselves about interactions.
